content:
We need to evaluate model using test set and cross-validation. Tools: evaluate_xgboost_model and perform_cross_validation. Provide paths.

Model path: /Users/.../2_train_xgboost_formation_energy_model_trial_3/trained_xgboost_model.pkl

Test data path: from metadata: test_path = .../test.csv

Cross-validation: need training data path: train_path.

We need to call evaluate_xgboost_model with detailed_analysis True. Then perform_cross_validation with cv_folds 5.

Then combine results into JSON with keys test_set_evaluation and cross_validation_results. Save to results file in workspace: /Users/.../2_evaluate_model_performance_trial_3/model_evaluation_results.json

We need to write file.

First call evaluate_xgboost_model.
